NewsArticle.Title: Copy and Paste
NewsArticle.Content: Client copy and paste is not available. It will be available in the next client. Dark Ages servers are fast and stable; running well below maximum load with 0 server lag at peak volume. If you do experience latency, test your connection ( [http://www.darkages.com/support/trace_route.htm](http://www.darkages.com/support/trace_route.htm) ).
